title: the ultimate create mod
description: its a awesome create modpack with all the popular create addons like cbc and connected
body:
Ultimate Create Mod is a Create-centered tech and automation pack for survival players, built on Minecraft 1.21.1 with NeoForge, that takes Create's signature mechanical contraptions and stretches them across nearly a dozen add-ons.
What it adds:

Create Big Cannons and Create Aeronautics bring artillery and flight into your factory builds, alongside Create Dragons Plus for dragon-related additions
Create Diesel Generators, Create Transmission, and Create Tweaked Controllers expand your power and motion systems beyond vanilla Create
Create Ore Excavation, Create Connected, Create Enchantment Industry, Create Deco, and Create Goggles round out resource gathering, building flexibility, and enchanting automation
Copycats, Design n Decor, and Super Duper Vanilla give you extra blocks and decorative pieces so your contraptions look as good as they function

Quality of life and navigation:

Jade and JEI so you always know what you're looking at and how to make it
Xaero's Minimap & World Map (with Waystones integration) for getting around your factory sprawl
AppleSkin, Corpse, Dynamic Lights, and Full Brightness Toggle smooth out everyday survival annoyances

Performance & visuals:

Sodium for FPS, Iris for shader support, and New Glowing Ores so your mining runs are easier on the eyes

Why play it: If you love Create's mechanical puzzle-solving but want more depth — bigger machines, working vehicles, artillery, and a wider decoration palette — without losing performance or QoL essentials, this pack bundles all of that into one curated setup, tuned for solo or SMP survival worlds.
